"""Fresh v0.1 scan: normalize, observe mount realpaths and inspect local images.
Legacy collect() remains a parser/replayer of v0 snapshots, not a fresh host scan.
"""
import copy
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import stat
import tarfile
import tempfile
import uuid
from pathlib import Path
from deployment.normalize import normalize,canonical_profile
from deployment.pins import ENTRY,current_sources,known_generation,vaulted_file
from extractors.compose import collect,sha
from security_ir.validator import validate

def reference_policy(entry=None):
    tree=ast.parse((Path(entry) if entry else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'tools/deployment_container_entry.py').read_text())
    calls=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=='execv']
    if len(calls)!=1 or len(calls[0].args)!=2 or not isinstance(calls[0].args[1],ast.List):return None
    values=calls[0].args[1].elts;result={}
    for flag,role,count in [('--agents','agent',2),('--reviewers','reviewer',1),('--approvers','approver',1),('--admins','admin',1)]:
        hits=[i for i,n in enumerate(values) if isinstance(n,ast.Constant) and n.value==flag]
        if len(hits)!=1 or hits[0]+1>=len(values):return None
        value=values[hits[0]+1]
        if not isinstance(value,ast.Constant) or not isinstance(value.value,str):return None
        try:uids=sorted(int(x) for x in value.value.split(','))
        except ValueError:return None
        if len(set(uids))!=count or any(x<=0 for x in uids):return None
        result[role]=uids
    return result

ENTRY_FLAGS={'--db','--socket','--agents','--reviewers','--approvers','--admins','--bootstrap-cap'}

def delegation_enabled(entry=None):
    """True unless the reference entry provably starts the broker without delegation: every element of the execv
    argument list must be a string constant, and every flag must be on the exact allowlist (abbreviations, computed
    arguments and --allow-delegation are all treated as delegation enabled/unknown)."""
    tree=ast.parse((Path(entry) if entry else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'tools/deployment_container_entry.py').read_text())
    calls=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=='execv']
    if len(calls)!=1 or len(calls[0].args)!=2 or not isinstance(calls[0].args[1],ast.List):return True
    values=calls[0].args[1].elts
    # element 0 is the interpreter; then '-m trusted_stack.server'; then exact flags with constant values. The only computed
    # value allowed is str(<name>) directly after --bootstrap-cap (the budget read from /private/cap).
    rest=values[1:];flags=[]
    def constant(v):return isinstance(v,ast.Constant) and isinstance(v.value,str)
    if len(rest)<2 or not (constant(rest[0]) and constant(rest[1])) or [rest[0].value,rest[1].value]!=['-m','trusted_stack.server']:return True
    i=2
    while i<len(rest):
        flag=rest[i]
        if not constant(flag) or flag.value not in ENTRY_FLAGS or i+1>=len(rest):return True
        value=rest[i+1]
        if flag.value=='--bootstrap-cap':
            if not (isinstance(value,ast.Call) and isinstance(value.func,ast.Name) and value.func.id=='str' and len(value.args)==1 and isinstance(value.args[0],ast.Name)):return True
        elif not constant(value) or value.value.startswith('-'):return True
        i+=2
    return False

def capability_paths(members):
    """Files that carry file capabilities: docker export records them as the SCHILY.xattr.security.capability PAX header."""
    return sorted(m.name for m in members if any('security.capability' in key for key in m.pax_headers))

STARTUP_HOOKS={'sitecustomize','usercustomize'}

def slice_tree(members):
    """Everything the image holds under /slice (first on sys.path via PYTHONPATH): a stray module, .pyc or link there is code
    the entrypoint could import, so the whole tree is inventoried, not just the files the reference names."""
    return sorted([m.name.removeprefix('./').rstrip('/'),m.type.decode('ascii'),m.mode&0o7777,m.uid] for m in members if m.name.removeprefix('./').rstrip('/').split('/')[0]=='slice')

def startup_hooks(members):
    """Files the interpreter runs at start-up without being imported by name: any *.pth, and any path component whose module name is
    sitecustomize or usercustomize in any form (.py, .pyc, a package directory, an extension suffix)."""
    def hook(name):return name.endswith('.pth') or any(part.split('.',1)[0] in STARTUP_HOOKS for part in name.split('/'))
    return sorted(m.name for m in members if hook(m.name))

def slice_tree_problems(tree,source_names,blocked_uids=frozenset()):
    """[] when the inventory is exactly the reference tree: two directories and the named regular files, none writable by group
    or other and none owned by a role UID. Anything else is reported by name."""
    expected={'slice':'5','slice/trusted_stack':'5',**{name:'0' for name in source_names}}
    problems=[]
    seen={}
    for entry in tree:
        if not (isinstance(entry,list) and len(entry)==4 and isinstance(entry[0],str)):return ['malformed inventory']
        name,kind,mode,uid=entry;seen[name]=kind
        if name not in expected:problems.append('unexpected '+name)
        elif kind!=expected[name]:problems.append('wrong type '+name)
        elif not isinstance(mode,int) or mode&0o022:problems.append('group/other-writable '+name)
        elif uid in blocked_uids:problems.append('agent-owned '+name)
    problems+=['missing '+name for name in expected if name not in seen]
    return problems

def inspect_image(image):
    try:
        p=subprocess.run(['docker','image','inspect',image],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
        if p.returncode:return {'status':'UNKNOWN','reason':'local image unavailable'}
        row=json.loads(p.stdout)[0];config=row['Config']
        if config.get('Volumes'):return {'status':'UNKNOWN','reason':'image-declared volumes not supported'}
        name='cstack-r2-image-audit-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
        created_id=None
        try:
            created=subprocess.run(['docker','create','--name',name,'--network','none','--user','23705','--entrypoint','/usr/bin/true',image],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
            if created.returncode:return {'status':'UNKNOWN','reason':'offline image export unavailable'}
            created_id=created.stdout.strip()
            with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cstack-r2-image-audit-',dir=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'.git') as tmp:
                archive=Path(tmp)/'rootfs.tar'
                with archive.open('wb') as f:
                    exported=subprocess.run(['docker','export',name],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=30)
                if exported.returncode:return {'status':'UNKNOWN','reason':'offline image export failed'}
                with tarfile.open(archive) as tar:
                    members=tar.getmembers()
                    inventory=sorted((m.name,m.mode,m.uid,m.gid,m.type.decode('ascii')) for m in members)
                    wanted={'slice/entry.py',*[('slice/trusted_stack/'+f.name) for f in (Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'trusted_stack').glob('*.py')]}
                    sources={m.name.removeprefix('./'):hashlib.sha256(tar.extractfile(m).read()).hexdigest() for m in members if m.isfile() and m.name.removeprefix('./') in wanted}
                setid=[name for name,mode,*_ in inventory if mode&0o6000];file_capabilities=capability_paths(members)
                tree=slice_tree(members);hooks=startup_hooks(members)
                return {'status':'OBSERVED','slice_tree':tree,'startup_hooks':hooks,'image':row['Id'],'image_user':config.get('User',''),'entrypoint':config.get('Entrypoint'),'command':config.get('Cmd'),'setid_paths':setid,'file_capability_paths':file_capabilities,'export_sha256':sha(archive),'source_sha256':sources,'mode_inventory_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(inventory,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(),'principal_policy':reference_policy(),'inspection':'stopped create with network none, numeric UID 23705, harmless overridden entrypoint; export; rm; never start','basis':'Docker inspect/export; daemon observations, not attestation'}
        finally:
            if created_id:subprocess.run(['docker','rm',created_id],capture_output=True,timeout=10)
    except (OSError,ValueError,subprocess.SubprocessError,tarfile.TarError):return {'status':'UNKNOWN','reason':'offline image inspection unavailable'}

def scan(compose,runtime,expected_sha256,output,image_observer=inspect_image,observed_snapshot=None,fresh_rules=False):
    """observed_snapshot replays archived observations. Replay normally applies the rules the archive was produced under (older
    inventories and images lack newer facts); fresh_rules=True replays the SAME observations under the fresh-scan rules, which is how
    a fresh scan's own IR is reproduced exactly."""
    fresh=observed_snapshot is None or fresh_rules
    output=Path(output);output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    if observed_snapshot is None:cp,metadata=normalize(compose,output,expected_sha256)
    else:
        if sha(compose)!=expected_sha256:raise ValueError('Compose pin mismatch')
        cp=output/'normalized.compose.json'
        try:input_json=json.loads(Path(compose).read_text())
        except json.JSONDecodeError:input_json={}
        assert canonical_profile(json.loads((output/'compose-cli.json').read_text()),input_json)==json.loads(cp.read_text())
        metadata=json.loads((output/'normalization.json').read_text())
        assert metadata['source_raw_sha256']==sha(compose) and metadata['cli_output_sha256']==sha(output/'compose-cli.json') and metadata['canonical_output_sha256']==sha(cp)
    original=json.loads(cp.read_text());c=copy.deepcopy(original);r=json.loads(Path(runtime).read_text())
    resolutions=copy.deepcopy(observed_snapshot['resolutions']) if observed_snapshot is not None else {};issues={};images=copy.deepcopy(observed_snapshot['images']) if observed_snapshot is not None else {}
    def resolve(source):
        if not isinstance(source,str) or not source.startswith('/') or '$' in source:return None
        if source not in resolutions:
            if observed_snapshot is not None:return None
            try:
                resolved=Path(source).resolve(strict=True);st=resolved.stat()
                resolutions[source]={'status':'OBSERVED','realpath':str(resolved),'uid':st.st_uid,'mode':oct(st.st_mode&0o7777),'device':st.st_dev,'inode':st.st_ino,'type':'directory' if stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) else 'other'}
            except (OSError,RuntimeError):resolutions[source]={'status':'UNKNOWN','reason':'mount source cannot be resolved'}
        return resolutions[source].get('realpath')
    for key in ('sink_source','database_source','channel_source'):
        path=c.get('x-cstack',{}).get(key);real=resolve(path)
        if real:c['x-cstack'][key]=real
    for name,s in c['services'].items():
        issues[name]=[]
        for m in s.get('volumes',[]):
            if isinstance(m,dict) and m.get('type')=='bind':
                real=resolve(m.get('source'))
                if real:m['source']=real
                else:issues[name].append('unresolved-mount-source')
        observed=r.get('services',{}).get(name,{})
        mounts=observed.get('mounts',[]) if isinstance(observed,dict) else []
        for m in mounts if isinstance(mounts,list) else []:
            if isinstance(m,dict) and m.get('type')=='bind':
                real=resolve(m.get('source'))
                if real:m['source']=real
                else:issues[name].append('unresolved-runtime-mount-source')
        if isinstance(mounts,list) and all(isinstance(m,dict) and isinstance(m.get('source'),str) and isinstance(m.get('target'),str) for m in mounts):mounts.sort(key=lambda m:(m['source'],m['target']))
        image=s.get('image','')
        if image not in images:images[image]=image_observer(image)
        audit=images[image]
        # v2 inventories (and every fresh scan) must establish that agents cannot regain capabilities (T9.4).
        # Archived v1 inventories predate the field and are replayed under the rules they were produced with.
        v2=fresh or (isinstance(observed,dict) and 'hardening' in observed)
        if fresh and s.get('x-cstack-role')=='agent' and not (isinstance(observed,dict) and 'hardening' in observed):
            issues[name].append('runtime-inventory-lacks-hardening-facts-UNKNOWN')  # the agent rule itself lives in collect()
        if audit['status']=='UNKNOWN':issues[name].append('image-inspection-UNKNOWN: '+audit['reason'])
        else:
            if audit['setid_paths']:issues[name].append('image-setuid-setgid-binaries')
            if v2:
                file_capabilities=audit.get('file_capability_paths')
                if not isinstance(file_capabilities,list):issues[name].append('image-file-capability-inventory-UNKNOWN')
                elif file_capabilities:issues[name].append('image-file-capabilities')
            if fresh or 'slice_tree' in audit:
                # Fresh scans must see the whole /slice tree and the start-up hooks; archived audits predate both fields.
                hooks=audit.get('startup_hooks')
                if not isinstance(hooks,list):issues[name].append('image-startup-hook-inventory-UNKNOWN')
                elif hooks:issues[name].append('image-python-startup-hooks')
                if not isinstance(audit.get('slice_tree'),list):issues[name].append('image-slice-tree-inventory-UNKNOWN')
            if audit['entrypoint']!=['/usr/bin/python3','/slice/entry.py'] or audit['command']:issues[name].append('image-entrypoint-command-uninspected')
            expected_sources=current_sources();policy_entry=None
            if observed_snapshot is not None and audit.get('source_sha256')!=expected_sources and known_generation(audit.get('source_sha256')):
                # Replay of archived evidence: the image carried an earlier vaulted generation, so compare against that
                # generation (and read its entry's policy). A fresh scan never takes this branch.
                expected_sources=audit['source_sha256'];policy_entry=vaulted_file(ENTRY,expected_sources['slice/entry.py'])
            if audit.get('source_sha256')!=expected_sources:issues[name].append('image-reference-source-correspondence-UNKNOWN')
            if not isinstance(s.get('user'),str) or not s['user'].isdecimal():issues[name].append('image-USER-not-explicitly-overridden')
            policy=reference_policy(policy_entry) if audit.get('source_sha256')==expected_sources else None
            blocked={u for uids in (policy or {}).values() for u in uids if isinstance(uids,list)}
            if isinstance(audit.get('slice_tree'),list) and slice_tree_problems(audit['slice_tree'],expected_sources,blocked):issues[name].append('image-slice-tree-differs-from-reference-UNKNOWN')
            if policy is not None and delegation_enabled(policy_entry):issues[name].append('broker-delegation-enabled-outside-claim-UNKNOWN')
            if 'principal_policy' in audit and audit['principal_policy']!=policy:issues[name].append('image-principal-policy-evidence-mismatch-UNKNOWN')
            role=s.get('x-cstack-role');policy_role='admin' if role in {'broker','receiver'} else role
            if not isinstance(policy,dict) or not isinstance(s.get('user'),str) or not s['user'].isdecimal() or int(s['user']) not in policy.get(policy_role,[]):issues[name].append('image-principal-policy-mismatch-UNKNOWN')
            env=s.get('environment',{})
            if env.get('PYTHONPATH')!='/slice' or (env.get('SLICE_ROLE')=='broker')!=(role=='broker'):issues[name].append('reference-entry-environment-mismatch-UNKNOWN')
    for key,service in [('sink_source','receiver'),('database_source','broker')]:
        path=original.get('x-cstack',{}).get(key)
        fact=resolutions.get(path,{}) if isinstance(path,str) else {}
        uid=c['services'].get(service,{}).get('user','')
        if fact.get('status')!='OBSERVED' or not uid.isdecimal() or fact.get('uid')!=int(uid) or fact.get('type')!='directory' or int(fact.get('mode','0'),8)&0o077 or int(fact.get('mode','0'),8)&0o700!=0o700:
            if service in issues:issues[service].append('private-store-custody-UNKNOWN')
    channel=original.get('x-cstack',{}).get('channel_source')
    fact=resolutions.get(channel,{}) if isinstance(channel,str) else {}
    uid=c['services'].get('broker',{}).get('user','')
    if fact.get('type')!='directory' or not uid.isdecimal() or fact.get('uid')!=int(uid) or int(fact.get('mode','0'),8)!=0o755:
        if 'broker' in issues:issues['broker'].append('channel-custody-access-UNKNOWN')
    # Derived canonical snapshots are the IR provenance. Original byte pins and
    # CLI version/output are retained separately, so whitespace cannot change IR.
    cp=output/'resolved.compose.json';rp=output/'resolved.runtime.json'
    if observed_snapshot is None:
        cp.write_text(json.dumps(c,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n');rp.write_text(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
    else:assert json.loads(cp.read_text())==c and json.loads(rp.read_text())==r
    raw_exports={image:audit.pop('export_sha256') for image,audit in images.items() if 'export_sha256' in audit}
    if observed_snapshot is None:(output/'image-export-capture.json').write_text(json.dumps(raw_exports,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
    facts={'resolutions':resolutions,'images':images}
    facts_path=output/'host-observations.json'
    if observed_snapshot is None:facts_path.write_text(json.dumps(facts,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
    else:assert json.loads(facts_path.read_text())==facts
    ir=collect(cp,rp,sha(cp),replay=not fresh);ir['version']='0.1'
    provenance={'source':str(facts_path),'sha256':sha(facts_path),'kind':'RUNTIME_OBSERVED'};ir['sources'].append(provenance)
    for service,reasons in issues.items():
        if reasons:
            existing=next((e for e in ir['edges'] if e['from']==service and e['to']=='unknown' and e['capability']=='opaque'),None)
            reason='; '.join(sorted(set(reasons)))
            if existing:existing['reason']+='; '+reason;existing['reachability']='UNKNOWN';existing['provenance']=dict(provenance,kind='UNKNOWN')
            else:ir['edges'].append({'from':service,'to':'unknown','capability':'opaque','reachability':'UNKNOWN','authorization':'UNKNOWN','provenance':dict(provenance,kind='UNKNOWN'),'reason':reason})
    ir['edges'].sort(key=lambda e:(e['from'],e['to'],e['capability']))
    return validate(ir)


def replay_snapshot(compose,runtime,output,fresh_rules=False):
    """Reconstruct an archived observation; this is not a fresh host assessment."""
    output=Path(output);facts=json.loads((output/'host-observations.json').read_text())
    def no_new_observation(image):raise AssertionError('archived image observation missing')
    return scan(compose,runtime,sha(compose),output,no_new_observation,facts,fresh_rules)

"""Dependency-free validator for the explicit JSON Schema subset used here.
Unknown schema keywords and external references fail; no schema is downloaded.
"""
import math
import re

class UnsupportedSchema(ValueError):pass

def validate(value,schema,root=None,path='$'):
    root=schema if root is None else root
    allowed={'$schema','$id','$defs','$ref','title','description','type','properties','required','additionalProperties','items','minItems','maxItems','minLength','pattern','minimum','maximum','enum','const','anyOf','oneOf','allOf'}
    if not isinstance(schema,dict) or set(schema)-allowed:raise UnsupportedSchema(path+': unsupported schema keyword or schema shape')
    def need(ok,message):
        if not ok:raise ValueError(path+': '+message)
    if '$ref' in schema:
        reference=schema['$ref']
        if not isinstance(reference,str) or not reference.startswith('#/'):raise UnsupportedSchema(path+': external schema reference unsupported')
        target=root
        for part in reference[2:].split('/'):target=target[part.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')]
        validate(value,target,root,path)
    for key in ('anyOf','oneOf'):
        if key in schema:
            count=0
            for branch in schema[key]:
                try:validate(value,branch,root,path);count+=1
                except UnsupportedSchema:raise
                except ValueError:pass
            need(count==1 if key=='oneOf' else count>=1,key+' branches do not match')
    for branch in schema.get('allOf',[]):validate(value,branch,root,path)
    types={'object':isinstance(value,dict),'array':isinstance(value,list),'string':isinstance(value,str),'boolean':type(value) is bool,'integer':type(value) is int,'number':type(value) is int or type(value) is float and math.isfinite(value),'null':value is None}
    if 'type' in schema:
        choices=schema['type'] if isinstance(schema['type'],list) else [schema['type']]
        need(all(t in types for t in choices),'unsupported type');need(any(types[t] for t in choices),'wrong value type')
    if 'const' in schema:need(type(value) is type(schema['const']) and value==schema['const'],'wrong constant')
    if 'enum' in schema:need(any(type(value) is type(candidate) and value==candidate for candidate in schema['enum']),'not in enum')
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        need(all(key in value for key in schema.get('required',[])),'missing required field')
        properties=schema.get('properties',{})
        for key,item in value.items():
            child=properties.get(key,schema.get('additionalProperties',True))
            need(child is not False,'extra field '+key)
            if isinstance(child,dict):validate(item,child,root,path+'.'+key)
    if isinstance(value,list):
        need(len(value)>=schema.get('minItems',0),'too few items');need(len(value)<=schema.get('maxItems',len(value)),'too many items')
        if 'items' in schema:
            for index,item in enumerate(value):validate(item,schema['items'],root,path+'['+str(index)+']')
    if isinstance(value,str):
        need(len(value)>=schema.get('minLength',0),'string too short')
        if 'pattern' in schema:need(re.search(schema['pattern'],value) is not None,'pattern mismatch')
    if type(value) in (int,float):
        need(type(value) is int or math.isfinite(value),'non-finite JSON number')
        if 'minimum' in schema:need(value>=schema['minimum'],'below minimum')
        if 'maximum' in schema:need(value<=schema['maximum'],'above maximum')
    return value

"""Sink-side audit independent of reconcile.py: file -> release direction and delegation use.
A file is attributed only if its name is the canonical <release_id>.body AND its bytes hash to that release's digest;
aliased names (leading zeros, non-ASCII digits) are reported as non-body files.
Reads only the saved SQLite backup and the copied sink directory of one finished case.
"""
import hashlib
import re
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

CANONICAL=re.compile(r'[1-9][0-9]*\.body')  # ASCII digits, no leading zero: exactly the receiver's str(release_id)+'.body'

def audit(final):
    final=Path(final);db=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(final/'database.sqlite')+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
    try:
        releases=dict(db.execute('select id,digest from releases'))
        count=lambda table:db.execute('select count(*) from '+table).fetchone()[0]
        delegations,delegated=count('delegations'),count('delegated_releases')
    finally:db.close()
    # .gitkeep is the repository placeholder for an archived empty sink, never a broker output.
    names=sorted(p.name for p in (final/'sink').iterdir() if p.name!='.gitkeep')
    body=[n for n in names if CANONICAL.fullmatch(n)]
    def attributed(name):
        path=final/'sink'/name;release=int(name[:-5])
        return release in releases and path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==releases[release]
    return {'delegations':delegations,'delegated_releases':delegated,
            'non_body_files':[n for n in names if n not in body],
            'unattributed_files':[n for n in body if not attributed(n)]}

def clean(result):return not (result['delegations'] or result['delegated_releases'] or result['non_body_files'] or result['unattributed_files'])

====================================================================================================
FILE: docs/flexibility-test/SC90TrustedMonitorAudit.lean
====================================================================================================

/-
SC-90: trusted monitoring with a finite audit budget, as a transactional gate (FLEXIBILITY TEST, not evidence).

Started from `tools/new_scenario.py` (spec `/tmp/sc90.json`, copy in `docs/flexibility-test/sc90.json`); every
declaration after the skeleton's `Payload`/`Roles`/`Checks` was written by hand.

Protocol (Redwood "trusted monitoring + audit budget"; Greenblatt et al. 2024). An agent proposes actions. A trusted
monitor records, for each request, a FLAG or PASS verdict (any verdict whatsoever: the monitor's quality is NOT
modelled, so the theorems hold for the worst monitor). A PASSed request executes. A FLAGGED request executes only if
an auditor has audited it and the audit found nothing. The auditor has a finite budget of `B` audits in total. An audit
that finds harm HALTs the gate (catch = absorbing shutdown, scaffold assumption A11). A flagged request that is not
audited (budget exhausted, or no auditor acts) simply does not execute: the protocol BLOCKS rather than defers.

Main results (all for configurations satisfying `Sound`, from `init`, over legal traces):
- `sc90_safe`: every ledger entry has a request with exactly that payload and was CLEARED (monitor PASS, or monitor FLAG
  plus an audit with no finding); ledger keys are unique; at most `B` ledger entries are flagged ones (i.e. at most
  `B` effects ever ran on the strength of an audit); a caught audit implies HALT.
- `harmful_effect_is_a_miss`: a harmful payload (ground-truth label `Payload.harm`, invisible to the gate) reaches the
  ledger only if the monitor PASSed it or the audit that cleared it reported no finding.
- `only_monitor_misses_escape`: if audits have perfect recall on harmful payloads (a PREMISE on the audit log, not a
  fact about the gate), every harmful effect is a monitor miss.
- `exhausted_blocks`: once the budget is spent, a flagged and unaudited request never executes on any legal trace.
- `halt_freezes`: with `haltCheck`, nothing is appended to the ledger after a halt (atomic delivery: this model has no
  in-flight messages).
Necessity witnesses: one per check (`no_<check>_breaks`).

NOT covered (and not expressible by `new_scenario.py`'s spec): the probability that the monitor misses (recall, false
positive rate), random or spot audits of PASSed requests, the monitor's score or threshold, the attacker's
adaptivity, audit recall below 1, the cost of blocking (usefulness), in-flight effects at HALT, and any link to the
probabilistic theorems in `AuditBudget.lean` / `DeferGame.lean` / `ReservedRecall.lean`. This file is the deterministic
gate half only. Credential separation (`legal`) is a premise: untrusted operations never carry the gate's credential;
and an op with a role's UID is read as that role's genuine act.
-/
import Mathlib.Tactic
import ControlStack.Core.Gate

set_option linter.unnecessarySeqFocus false

namespace ControlStack.SC90

open ControlStack.Gate

/-- the effect payload (`harm` is ground truth, visible to no gate check) -/
structure Payload where
  dest : ℕ
  harm : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- trusted role assignment (by OS identity); `gate` is the gate's own credential, the only one the external
system accepts -/
structure Roles where
  agents : List ℕ
  monitors : List ℕ
  auditors : List ℕ
  admins : List ℕ
  gate : ℕ

structure Req where
  id : ℕ
  requester : ℕ
  p : Payload
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure St where
  /-- next request id (also the idempotency key) -/
  next : ℕ
  /-- absorbing HALT bit -/
  halted : Bool
  /-- the external system's append-only effect log, keyed by request id: (key, payload) -/
  ledger : List (ℕ × Payload)
  reqs : List Req
  /-- monitor log: (request id, flag) -/
  verdicts : List (ℕ × Bool)
  /-- auditor log: (request id, caught) -/
  audits : List (ℕ × Bool)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive Op where
  /-- an agent proposes an action with payload `p` -/
  | request (caller : ℕ) (p : Payload)
  /-- the trusted monitor records its flag verdict for request `id` (first verdict wins) -/
  | monitor (caller : ℕ) (id : ℕ) (flag : Bool)
  /-- an auditor spends one unit of audit budget on flagged request `id`; `caught` is the audit finding -/
  | audit (caller : ℕ) (id : ℕ) (caught : Bool)
  /-- the gate executes request `id` against the external system -/
  | execute (caller : ℕ) (id : ℕ)
  /-- a direct call to the external system by `caller` -/
  | directCall (caller : ℕ) (key : ℕ) (p : Payload)
  /-- trusted HALT by an admin (added by the generator) -/
  | halt (caller : ℕ)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- which checks the implementation performs; `full` is the deployed configuration -/
structure Checks where
  /-- execution needs a monitor verdict (control finding c1) -/
  monitorGate : Bool
  /-- a flagged request executes only after an audit that found nothing (control finding c2) -/
  auditGate : Bool
  /-- at most B audits are ever performed (control finding c3) -/
  budget : Bool
  /-- an audit that finds harm sets HALT (control finding c4) -/
  haltOnCatch : Bool
  /-- the external system accepts only the gate credential (control finding c5) -/
  auth : Bool
  /-- the external system is idempotent per key (control finding c6) -/
  dedup : Bool
  /-- every gate operation checks the HALT bit (control finding c7) -/
  haltCheck : Bool
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def full : Checks := { monitorGate := true, auditGate := true, budget := true, haltOnCatch := true, auth := true, dedup := true, haltCheck := true }

/-- the checks the SAFETY property needs. `haltCheck` is not among them: it is needed only for `halt_freezes`. -/
structure Sound (C : Checks) : Prop where
  monitorGate : C.monitorGate = true
  auditGate : C.auditGate = true
  budget : C.budget = true
  haltOnCatch : C.haltOnCatch = true
  auth : C.auth = true
  dedup : C.dedup = true

theorem sound_full : Sound full := ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

def init : St := { next := 0, halted := false, ledger := [], reqs := [], verdicts := [], audits := [] }

def reqOf (s : St) (id : ℕ) : Option Req := s.reqs.find? (fun r => r.id = id)

/-- the external system appends an entry unless (when idempotent) the key is already present -/
def ledgerAppend (C : Checks) (s : St) (key : ℕ) (p : Payload) : St :=
  if C.dedup ∧ key ∈ s.ledger.map Prod.fst then s else { s with ledger := s.ledger ++ [(key, p)] }

/-- the gate's clearance test for request `id` under configuration `C` -/
def cleared (C : Checks) (s : St) (id : ℕ) : Prop :=
  C.monitorGate → ((id, false) ∈ s.verdicts ∨ ((id, true) ∈ s.verdicts ∧ (C.auditGate → (id, false) ∈ s.audits)))

instance (C : Checks) (s : St) (id : ℕ) : Decidable (cleared C s id) := by unfold cleared; infer_instance

/-- the transition function; `B` is the total audit budget -/
def step (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) (C : Checks) (s : St) : Op → St
  | .request c p =>
    if s.halted ∧ C.haltCheck then s
    else if c ∈ R.agents then { s with reqs := s.reqs ++ [⟨s.next, c, p⟩], next := s.next + 1 } else s
  | .monitor c id f =>
    if s.halted ∧ C.haltCheck then s
    else if c ∈ R.monitors ∧ id ∉ s.verdicts.map Prod.fst then { s with verdicts := s.verdicts ++ [(id, f)] } else s
  | .audit c id caught =>
    if s.halted ∧ C.haltCheck then s
    else if c ∈ R.auditors ∧ (id, true) ∈ s.verdicts ∧ id ∉ s.audits.map Prod.fst ∧
        (C.budget → s.audits.length < B) then
      { s with audits := s.audits ++ [(id, caught)], halted := s.halted || (caught && C.haltOnCatch) }
    else s
  | .execute _ id =>
    if s.halted ∧ C.haltCheck then s
    else match reqOf s id with
      | none => s
      | some r => if cleared C s id then ledgerAppend C s id r.p else s
  | .directCall c key p => if C.auth ∧ c ≠ R.gate then s else ledgerAppend C s key p
  | .halt c => if c ∈ R.admins then { s with halted := true } else s

def run (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) (C : Checks) (s : St) (ops : List Op) : St := ops.foldl (step R B C) s

/-- untrusted operations never carry the gate's credential (credential separation, a correspondence premise) -/
def legal (R : Roles) : Op → Prop
  | .directCall c _ _ => c ≠ R.gate
  | _ => True

/-- the gate as a `Gate.System` over legal operations; its effect log is `St.ledger` -/
def sys (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) : System St {o : Op // legal R o} (ℕ × Payload) where
  step := fun s o => step R B full s o.1
  effects := St.ledger

/-- witness roles: role i gets UID i+1 (in the order of the spec); the gate credential is 9 -/
def R0 : Roles := ⟨[1], [2], [3], [4], 9⟩

/-- sanity: the empty trace is the initial state -/
example : run R0 1 full init [] = init := rfl

/-! ## The invariant and the safety property -/

/-- the monitor passed the request, or flagged it and an audit found nothing -/
def Cleared (s : St) (k : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (k, false) ∈ s.verdicts ∨ ((k, true) ∈ s.verdicts ∧ (k, false) ∈ s.audits)

structure Inv (B : ℕ) (s : St) : Prop where
  ledger_ok : ∀ e ∈ s.ledger, ∃ r, reqOf s e.1 = some r ∧ r.p = e.2 ∧ Cleared s e.1
  ledger_nd : (s.ledger.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  verd_nd : (s.verdicts.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  aud_nd : (s.audits.map Prod.fst).Nodup
  aud_le : s.audits.length ≤ B
  caught_halts : ∀ a ∈ s.audits, a.2 = true → s.halted = true

/-- entries whose monitor verdict was FLAG: each ran only on the strength of an audit -/
def flaggedEffects (s : St) : List (ℕ × Payload) := s.ledger.filter (fun e => decide ((e.1, true) ∈ s.verdicts))

/-- the safety property -/
def Good (B : ℕ) (s : St) : Prop :=
  (∀ e ∈ s.ledger, ∃ r, reqOf s e.1 = some r ∧ r.p = e.2 ∧ Cleared s e.1) ∧
  (s.ledger.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
  (flaggedEffects s).length ≤ B ∧
  (∀ a ∈ s.audits, a.2 = true → s.halted = true)

theorem inv_init (B : ℕ) : Inv B init :=
  ⟨by simp [init], by simp [init], by simp [init], by simp [init], by simp [init], by simp [init]⟩

theorem Cleared.mono {s t : St} (hV : s.verdicts ⊆ t.verdicts) (hA : s.audits ⊆ t.audits) {k : ℕ}
    (h : Cleared s k) : Cleared t k := by
  rcases h with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact Or.inl (hV h)
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hV h1, hA h2⟩

theorem reqOf_append (s : St) (l : List Req) (k : ℕ) (r : Req) (h : reqOf s k = some r) :
    reqOf { s with reqs := s.reqs ++ l } k = some r := by
  simp only [reqOf] at h ⊢
  simp [List.find?_append, h]

/-- under `Inv`, a flagged ledger entry's key is an audited key; so flagged entries inject into audits -/
theorem Inv.flagged_le {B : ℕ} {s : St} (h : Inv B s) : (flaggedEffects s).length ≤ B := by
  have hnd : ((flaggedEffects s).map Prod.fst).Nodup :=
    h.ledger_nd.sublist (List.Sublist.map _ (List.filter_sublist))
  have hsub : ((flaggedEffects s).map Prod.fst) ⊆ s.audits.map Prod.fst := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hk
    simp only [flaggedEffects, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq] at he
    obtain ⟨he, hv⟩ := he
    obtain ⟨r, -, -, hc⟩ := h.ledger_ok e he
    rcases hc with hc | ⟨-, hc⟩
    · exfalso
      -- (k,false) and (k,true) both in verdicts contradicts key-uniqueness
      have := List.inj_on_of_nodup_map h.verd_nd hc hv rfl
      simp at this
    · exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨_, hc, rfl⟩
  have := (List.Nodup.subperm hnd hsub).length_le
  simp only [List.length_map] at this
  exact this.trans h.aud_le

theorem Inv.good {B : ℕ} {s : St} (h : Inv B s) : Good B s :=
  ⟨h.ledger_ok, h.ledger_nd, h.flagged_le, h.caught_halts⟩

theorem cleared_sound {C : Checks} (hC : Sound C) {s : St} {k : ℕ} (h : cleared C s k) : Cleared s k := by
  rcases h hC.monitorGate with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨h1, h2 hC.auditGate⟩

theorem ledgerAppend_inv {B : ℕ} {C : Checks} (hdd : C.dedup = true) {s : St} (h : Inv B s)
    (k : ℕ) (r : Req) (hr : reqOf s k = some r) (hcl : Cleared s k) : Inv B (ledgerAppend C s k r.p) := by
  unfold ledgerAppend
  by_cases hd : k ∈ s.ledger.map Prod.fst
  · simpa [hdd, hd] using h
  · simp only [hdd, true_and, hd, ite_false]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, h.verd_nd, h.aud_nd, h.aud_le, h.caught_halts⟩
    · intro e he
      rcases List.mem_append.1 he with he | he
      · exact h.ledger_ok e he
      · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at he
        subst he
        exact ⟨r, hr, rfl, hcl⟩
    · simp only [List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
      refine List.nodup_append.2 ⟨h.ledger_nd, List.nodup_singleton _, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩
      simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hb
      subst hb
      rintro rfl
      exact hd ha

theorem step_inv (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) {C : Checks} (hC : Sound C) (s : St) (o : Op) (ho : legal R o)
    (h : Inv B s) : Inv B (step R B C s o) := by
  cases o with
  | request c p =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact h
    · refine ⟨?_, h.ledger_nd, h.verd_nd, h.aud_nd, h.aud_le, h.caught_halts⟩
      intro e he
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hp, hcl⟩ := h.ledger_ok e he
      exact ⟨r, reqOf_append s _ _ r hr, hp, hcl⟩
    · exact h
  | monitor c id f =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact h
    · obtain ⟨-, hid⟩ := h2
      refine ⟨?_, h.ledger_nd, ?_, h.aud_nd, h.aud_le, h.caught_halts⟩
      · intro e he
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hp, hcl⟩ := h.ledger_ok e he
        exact ⟨r, hr, hp, hcl.mono (by intro x hx; simp [hx]) (by intro x hx; exact hx)⟩
      · simp only [List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
        refine List.nodup_append.2 ⟨h.verd_nd, List.nodup_singleton _, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩
        simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hb
        subst hb
        rintro rfl
        exact hid ha
    · exact h
  | audit c id caught =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact h
    · obtain ⟨-, -, hid, hb⟩ := h2
      refine ⟨?_, h.ledger_nd, h.verd_nd, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro e he
        obtain ⟨r, hr, hp, hcl⟩ := h.ledger_ok e he
        exact ⟨r, hr, hp, hcl.mono (by intro x hx; exact hx) (by intro x hx; simp [hx])⟩
      · simp only [List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
        refine List.nodup_append.2 ⟨h.aud_nd, List.nodup_singleton _, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩
        simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hb
        subst hb
        rintro rfl
        exact hid ha
      · have := hb hC.budget
        simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
        omega
      · intro a ha hat
        rcases List.mem_append.1 ha with ha | ha
        · simp [h.caught_halts a ha hat]
        · simp only [List.mem_singleton] at ha
          subst ha
          simp [show caught = true from hat, hC.haltOnCatch]
    · exact h
  | execute c id =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact h
    · split
      · exact h
      · rename_i r hr
        exact ledgerAppend_inv hC.dedup h id r hr (cleared_sound hC h2)
    · split <;> exact h
  | directCall c key p =>
    simp only [legal] at ho
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs with hh
    · exact h
    · exact absurd ⟨hC.auth, ho⟩ hh
  | halt c =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs with h1
    · refine ⟨h.ledger_ok, h.ledger_nd, h.verd_nd, h.aud_nd, h.aud_le, fun a _ _ => rfl⟩
    · exact h

theorem run_inv (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) {C : Checks} (hC : Sound C) (s : St) (ops : List Op)
    (hops : ∀ o ∈ ops, legal R o) (h : Inv B s) : Inv B (run R B C s ops) := by
  induction ops generalizing s with
  | nil => exact h
  | cons o ops ih =>
    exact ih (step R B C s o) (fun o' ho' => hops o' (List.mem_cons_of_mem o ho'))
      (step_inv R B hC s o (hops o List.mem_cons_self) h)

/-- **SC-90 safety.** After any legal trace from the initial state, `Good` holds. -/
theorem sc90_safe (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) (ops : List Op) (hops : ∀ o ∈ ops, legal R o) :
    Good B (run R B full init ops) :=
  (run_inv R B sound_full init ops hops (inv_init B)).good

/-! ## Consequences: where a harmful effect can come from -/

/-- every effect in the ledger was monitor-PASSed or audited with no finding -/
theorem harmful_effect_is_a_miss {B : ℕ} {s : St} (h : Good B s) :
    ∀ e ∈ s.ledger, e.2.harm = true → (e.1, false) ∈ s.verdicts ∨ (e.1, false) ∈ s.audits := by
  intro e he _
  obtain ⟨r, -, -, hc⟩ := h.1 e he
  rcases hc with hc | ⟨-, hc⟩
  · exact Or.inl hc
  · exact Or.inr hc

/-- PREMISE (a fact about the auditor, not the gate): every audit of a request with a harmful payload reports it -/
def AuditRecallPerfect (s : St) : Prop :=
  ∀ a ∈ s.audits, ∀ r, reqOf s a.1 = some r → r.p.harm = true → a.2 = true

/-- with perfect audit recall, only monitor misses reach the ledger -/
theorem only_monitor_misses_escape {B : ℕ} {s : St} (h : Good B s) (hrec : AuditRecallPerfect s) :
    ∀ e ∈ s.ledger, e.2.harm = true → (e.1, false) ∈ s.verdicts := by
  intro e he hharm
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp, hc⟩ := h.1 e he
  rcases hc with hc | ⟨-, hc⟩
  · exact hc
  · have := hrec _ hc r hr (by rw [hp]; exact hharm)
    simp at this

/-! ## Budget exhaustion blocks -/

theorem step_audits_exhausted (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) {C : Checks} (hC : Sound C) (s : St) (o : Op)
    (hex : B ≤ s.audits.length) : (step R B C s o).audits = s.audits := by
  cases o with
  | audit c id caught =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · rfl
    · have := h2.2.2.2 hC.budget
      omega
    · rfl
  | request c p => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> rfl
  | monitor c id f => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> rfl
  | execute c id =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs <;> (try split) <;> simp [ledgerAppend] <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  | directCall c key p => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> simp [ledgerAppend] <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  | halt c => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> rfl

theorem step_verdicts_mono (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) (C : Checks) (s : St) (o : Op) :
    s.verdicts ⊆ (step R B C s o).verdicts := by
  cases o with
  | monitor c id f =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs
    · exact fun _ hx => hx
    · intro x hx; simp [hx]
    · exact fun _ hx => hx
  | request c p => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> exact fun _ hx => hx
  | audit c id caught => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> exact fun _ hx => hx
  | execute c id =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs <;> (try split) <;> simp [ledgerAppend] <;> split_ifs <;> exact fun _ hx => hx
  | directCall c key p => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> simp [ledgerAppend] <;> split_ifs <;> exact fun _ hx => hx
  | halt c => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> exact fun _ hx => hx

theorem run_exhausted (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) {C : Checks} (hC : Sound C) (s : St) (ops : List Op)
    (hex : B ≤ s.audits.length) :
    (run R B C s ops).audits = s.audits ∧ s.verdicts ⊆ (run R B C s ops).verdicts := by
  induction ops generalizing s with
  | nil => exact ⟨rfl, fun _ hx => hx⟩
  | cons o ops ih =>
    have h1 := step_audits_exhausted R B hC s o hex
    obtain ⟨h2, h3⟩ := ih (step R B C s o) (by rw [h1]; exact hex)
    show (run R B C (step R B C s o) ops).audits = s.audits ∧
      s.verdicts ⊆ (run R B C (step R B C s o) ops).verdicts
    exact ⟨h2.trans h1, fun x hx => h3 (step_verdicts_mono R B C s o hx)⟩

/-- **Exhaustion blocks.** Once `B` audits have been spent, a flagged request that was never audited can never
execute, on any legal continuation: the budget is a hard cap on flagged effects, not a soft one. -/
theorem exhausted_blocks (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) {C : Checks} (hC : Sound C) {s : St} (h : Inv B s)
    (hex : B ≤ s.audits.length) {k : ℕ} (hk : (k, true) ∈ s.verdicts) (hna : k ∉ s.audits.map Prod.fst)
    (ops : List Op) (hops : ∀ o ∈ ops, legal R o) : k ∉ (run R B C s ops).ledger.map Prod.fst := by
  obtain ⟨hA, hV⟩ := run_exhausted R B hC s ops hex
  have hI := run_inv R B hC s ops hops h
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨e, he, hek⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hmem
  obtain ⟨r, -, -, hc⟩ := hI.ledger_ok e he
  rw [hek] at hc
  rcases hc with hc | ⟨-, hc⟩
  · have := List.inj_on_of_nodup_map hI.verd_nd hc (hV hk) rfl
    simp at this
  · rw [hA] at hc
    exact hna (List.mem_map.2 ⟨_, hc, rfl⟩)

/-! ## HALT -/

theorem step_halted (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) {C : Checks} (hh : C.haltCheck = true) (ha : C.auth = true) (s : St)
    (hs : s.halted = true) (o : Op) (ho : legal R o) : step R B C s o = s := by
  cases o with
  | request c p => simp [step, hs, hh]
  | monitor c id f => simp [step, hs, hh]
  | audit c id caught => simp [step, hs, hh]
  | execute c id => simp [step, hs, hh]
  | directCall c key p =>
    simp only [legal] at ho
    simp [step, ha, ho]
  | halt c =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs
    · cases s; simp_all
    · rfl

/-- **Halt freezes.** With the HALT check and receiver authentication, after a halt no legal operation changes
anything (in particular the ledger). In this model delivery is atomic: there are no in-flight messages to finish. -/
theorem halt_freezes (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) {C : Checks} (hh : C.haltCheck = true) (ha : C.auth = true) (s : St)
    (hs : s.halted = true) (ops : List Op) (hops : ∀ o ∈ ops, legal R o) : run R B C s ops = s := by
  induction ops with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons o ops ih =>
    show run R B C (step R B C s o) ops = s
    rw [step_halted R B hh ha s hs o (hops o List.mem_cons_self)]
    exact ih (fun o' ho' => hops o' (List.mem_cons_of_mem o ho'))

/-! ## The gate spec (reuse of `Core/Gate.lean`) -/

theorem step_ledger_prefix (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) (C : Checks) (s : St) (o : Op) :
    s.ledger <+: (step R B C s o).ledger := by
  cases o with
  | request c p => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> exact List.prefix_refl _
  | monitor c id f => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> exact List.prefix_refl _
  | audit c id caught => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> exact List.prefix_refl _
  | execute c id =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs <;> (try split) <;> (try simp only [ledgerAppend]) <;> (try split_ifs) <;>
      first | exact List.prefix_refl _ | exact List.prefix_append _ _
  | directCall c key p =>
    simp only [step]
    split_ifs <;> (try simp only [ledgerAppend]) <;> (try split_ifs) <;>
      first | exact List.prefix_refl _ | exact List.prefix_append _ _
  | halt c => simp only [step]; split_ifs <;> exact List.prefix_refl _

/-- the model is a client of the shared gate interface -/
def spec (R : Roles) (B : ℕ) : Spec (sys R B) where
  Inv := Inv B
  ok := fun s e => ∃ r, reqOf s e.1 = some r ∧ r.p = e.2 ∧ Cleared s e.1
  step_inv := fun s o h => step_inv R B sound_full s o.1 o.2 h
  log_prefix := fun s o => step_ledger_prefix R B full s o.1
  inv_ok := fun _ h e he => h.ledger_ok e he

/-! ## Non-vacuity and one necessity witness per check -/

/-- a harmful payload (ground truth) -/
def pH : Payload := ⟨5, true⟩
def pB : Payload := ⟨6, false⟩

/-- **Non-vacuity**: a PASSed request and an audited FLAGGED request both execute under the full gate -/
theorem honest_trace_effects :
    (run R0 1 full init [.request 1 pB, .monitor 2 0 false, .execute 1 0]).ledger = [(0, pB)] ∧
    (run R0 1 full init [.request 1 pB, .monitor 2 0 true, .audit 3 0 false, .execute 1 0]).ledger = [(0, pB)] := by
  decide

/-- **Exhaustion**: with budget 0, the audit is refused and the flagged request is blocked forever -/
theorem budget_zero_blocks :
    (run R0 0 full init [.request 1 pB, .monitor 2 0 true, .audit 3 0 false, .execute 1 0]).ledger = [] := by
  decide

/-- a caught audit halts, and the harmful request never runs -/
theorem caught_halts_and_blocks :
    (run R0 1 full init [.request 1 pH, .monitor 2 0 true, .audit 3 0 true, .execute 1 0]).ledger = [] ∧
    (run R0 1 full init [.request 1 pH, .monitor 2 0 true, .audit 3 0 true]).halted = true := by
  decide

/-- a harmful request the monitor PASSes executes: the gate cannot do better than the monitor (a monitor miss) -/
theorem monitor_miss_escapes :
    (run R0 1 full init [.request 1 pH, .monitor 2 0 false, .execute 1 0]).ledger = [(0, pH)] := by
  decide

theorem no_monitorGate_breaks :
    ¬ Good 1 (run R0 1 { full with monitorGate := false } init [.request 1 pH, .execute 1 0]) := by
  have hs : run R0 1 { full with monitorGate := false } init [.request 1 pH, .execute 1 0] =
      ⟨1, false, [(0, pH)], [⟨0, 1, pH⟩], [], []⟩ := by decide
  rw [hs]
  intro hg
  obtain ⟨r, -, -, hc⟩ := hg.1 (0, pH) (by simp)
  simp [Cleared] at hc

theorem no_auditGate_breaks :
    ¬ Good 1 (run R0 1 { full with auditGate := false } init [.request 1 pH, .monitor 2 0 true, .execute 1 0]) := by
  have hs : run R0 1 { full with auditGate := false } init [.request 1 pH, .monitor 2 0 true, .execute 1 0] =
      ⟨1, false, [(0, pH)], [⟨0, 1, pH⟩], [(0, true)], []⟩ := by decide
  rw [hs]
  intro hg
  obtain ⟨r, -, -, hc⟩ := hg.1 (0, pH) (by simp)
  simp [Cleared] at hc

/-- budget 1, two flagged requests both audited and run: the budget is exceeded -/
theorem no_budget_breaks :
    ¬ Good 1 (run R0 1 { full with budget := false } init
      [.request 1 pB, .request 1 pB, .monitor 2 0 true, .monitor 2 1 true, .audit 3 0 false, .audit 3 1 false,
       .execute 1 0, .execute 1 1]) := by
  have hs : run R0 1 { full with budget := false } init
      [.request 1 pB, .request 1 pB, .monitor 2 0 true, .monitor 2 1 true, .audit 3 0 false, .audit 3 1 false,
       .execute 1 0, .execute 1 1] =
      ⟨2, false, [(0, pB), (1, pB)], [⟨0, 1, pB⟩, ⟨1, 1, pB⟩], [(0, true), (1, true)], [(0, false), (1, false)]⟩ := by
    decide
  rw [hs]
  intro hg
  have := hg.2.2.1
  simp [flaggedEffects] at this

theorem no_haltOnCatch_breaks :
    ¬ Good 1 (run R0 1 { full with haltOnCatch := false } init [.request 1 pH, .monitor 2 0 true, .audit 3 0 true]) := by
  have hs : run R0 1 { full with haltOnCatch := false } init [.request 1 pH, .monitor 2 0 true, .audit 3 0 true] =
      ⟨1, false, [], [⟨0, 1, pH⟩], [(0, true)], [(0, true)]⟩ := by decide
  rw [hs]
  intro hg
  have := hg.2.2.2 (0, true) (by simp) rfl
  simp at this

theorem no_auth_breaks :
    legal R0 (.directCall 1 7 pH) ∧
    ¬ Good 1 (run R0 1 { full with auth := false } init [.directCall 1 7 pH]) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [legal, R0], ?_⟩
  have hs : run R0 1 { full with auth := false } init [.directCall 1 7 pH] =
      ⟨0, false, [(7, pH)], [], [], []⟩ := by decide
  rw [hs]
  intro hg
  obtain ⟨r, hr, -⟩ := hg.1 (7, pH) (by simp)
  simp [reqOf] at hr

theorem no_dedup_breaks :
    ¬ Good 1 (run R0 1 { full with dedup := false } init [.request 1 pB, .monitor 2 0 false, .execute 1 0, .execute 1 0]) := by
  have hs : run R0 1 { full with dedup := false } init [.request 1 pB, .monitor 2 0 false, .execute 1 0, .execute 1 0] =
      ⟨1, false, [(0, pB), (0, pB)], [⟨0, 1, pB⟩], [(0, false)], []⟩ := by decide
  rw [hs]
  intro hg
  have := hg.2.1
  simp at this

/-- without the HALT check a request executes after the halt; with it, nothing does -/
theorem no_haltCheck_breaks :
    (run R0 1 { full with haltCheck := false } init [.request 1 pH, .monitor 2 0 false, .halt 4, .execute 1 0]).ledger =
      [(0, pH)] ∧
    (run R0 1 full init [.request 1 pH, .monitor 2 0 false, .halt 4, .execute 1 0]).ledger = [] := by
  decide

end ControlStack.SC90

def Back (d : IR) : Prop := BaseAccepted d ∧ RoleChecked d ∧ IdentityEnglish d ∧ (∀ n ∈ d.nodes, n.runtimeMatch = true) ∧ WritersChecked d ∧ NoBypass d
def distinctBroker : IR := {clean with nodes := clean.nodes.map (fun n => if n.id = clean.broker then {n with uid := 23706} else n)}
def Claim : Prop := (∀ d, Accepted d → Back d) ∧ (Back distinctBroker ∧ ¬ Accepted distinctBroker)

end PL_g0_01

====================================================================================================
FILE: docs/lean-english/one-to-one/ProvenanceDraft.lean
====================================================================================================

import ControlStack.Deployment.R2Contracts
namespace ControlStack.Deployment.OneToOne
open ControlStack
open TrustedBroker

/-- Present review entries are authentic role assertions about existing artifacts.
This does not assert semantic harmlessness or retain the original reviewer after overwrite. -/
def ReviewProvenance (R : Roles) (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ digest reviewer, s.reviews digest = some reviewer →
    R.reviewer reviewer ∧ s.artifacts digest = true

/-- State-level ownership and review facts for each retained approval.
No release digest/destination log exists; no per-release matching assertion is made. -/
def ApprovalProvenance (R : Roles) (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ nonce a, s.approvals nonce = some a →
    R.approver a.signer ∧ R.agent a.agent ∧ s.artifacts a.digest = true ∧
    (∃ reviewer, s.reviews a.digest = some reviewer ∧ R.reviewer reviewer) ∧
    (∃ l, s.leases a.lease = some l ∧ l.agent = a.agent)

theorem initial_review (R : Roles) (cap : Nat) : ReviewProvenance R (initial cap) := by
  simp [ReviewProvenance, initial]
theorem initial_approval (R : Roles) (cap : Nat) : ApprovalProvenance R (initial cap) := by
  simp [ApprovalProvenance, initial]

theorem review_step (R : Roles) (s t : State)
    (h : ReviewProvenance R s) (step : Step R s t) : ReviewProvenance R t := by
  cases step with
  | stage uid digest live role =>
    intro key reviewer lookup
    obtain ⟨role, artifact⟩ := h key reviewer lookup
    exact ⟨role,by simp [put,artifact]⟩
  | review uid digest live role existsArtifact =>
    intro key reviewer lookup
    by_cases eq : key = digest
    · subst key
      simp [put] at lookup
      subst reviewer
      exact ⟨role,existsArtifact⟩
    · exact h key reviewer (by simpa [put,eq] using lookup)
  | release now r a l allowed => exact h
  | deny => exact h
  | issue => exact h
  | approve => exact h
  | revoke => exact h
  | halt => exact h

theorem approval_step (R : Roles) (s t : State)
    (reviews : ReviewProvenance R s) (h : ApprovalProvenance R s)
    (step : Step R s t) : ApprovalProvenance R t := by
  cases step with
  | deny => exact h
  | halt => exact h
  | stage uid digest live role =>
    intro nonce a lookup
    obtain ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,lease⟩ := h nonce a lookup
    exact ⟨signer,agent,by simp [put,artifact],review,lease⟩
  | review uid digest live role existsArtifact =>
    intro nonce a lookup
    obtain ⟨signer,agent,artifact,oldReview,lease⟩ := h nonce a lookup
    refine ⟨signer,agent,artifact,?_,lease⟩
    by_cases eq : a.digest = digest
    · exact ⟨uid,by simp [put,eq],role⟩
    · obtain ⟨reviewer,lookup,role⟩ := oldReview
      exact ⟨reviewer,by simpa [put,eq] using lookup,role⟩
  | issue uid key l now live role agent fresh budget unused active future =>
    intro nonce a lookup
    obtain ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,v,hv,owner⟩ := h nonce a lookup
    have ne : a.lease ≠ key := by intro eq; rw [eq,fresh] at hv; cases hv
    exact ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,v,by simpa [put,ne] using hv,owner⟩
  | revoke uid key l live role lease =>
    intro nonce a lookup
    obtain ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,v,hv,owner⟩ := h nonce a lookup
    refine ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,?_⟩
    by_cases eq : a.lease = key
    · rw [eq,lease] at hv
      have same : l = v := Option.some.inj hv
      subst v
      exact ⟨{l with revoked := true},by simp [put,eq],owner⟩
    · exact ⟨v,by simpa [put,eq] using hv,owner⟩
  | approve uid nonce a l now reviewer live role signer agent fresh unused review reviewRole distinct lease owner active leaseFuture future =>
    intro key b lookup
    by_cases eq : key = nonce
    · subst key
      simp [put] at lookup
      subst b
      exact ⟨signer.symm ▸ role,agent,(reviews a.digest reviewer review).2,⟨reviewer,review,reviewRole⟩,⟨l,lease,owner⟩⟩
    · exact h key b (by simpa [put,eq] using lookup)
  | release now r a l allowed =>
    intro key b lookup
    have old : ∃ v, s.approvals key = some v ∧ b = {v with used := true} ∨ s.approvals key = some b := by
      by_cases eq : key = r.nonce
      · subst key
        simp [committed,put] at lookup
        exact ⟨a,Or.inl ⟨allowed.2.2.1,lookup.symm⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨b,Or.inr (by simpa [committed,put,eq] using lookup)⟩
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := old
    have data : R.approver b.signer ∧ R.agent b.agent ∧ s.artifacts b.digest = true ∧
        (∃ reviewer, s.reviews b.digest = some reviewer ∧ R.reviewer reviewer) ∧
        (∃ v, s.leases b.lease = some v ∧ v.agent = b.agent) := by
      rcases hv with ⟨hv,rfl⟩ | hv
      · exact h key v hv
      · exact h key b hv
    obtain ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,v,hv,owner⟩ := data
    refine ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,?_⟩
    by_cases eq : b.lease = r.lease
    · rw [eq,allowed.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1] at hv
      have same : l = v := Option.some.inj hv
      subst v
      exact ⟨{l with used := l.used + r.cost},by simp [committed,put,eq],owner⟩
    · exact ⟨v,by simpa [committed,put,eq] using hv,owner⟩

theorem trace_provenance (R : Roles) (s t : State)
    (review : ReviewProvenance R s) (approval : ApprovalProvenance R s)
    (trace : Trace R s t) : ReviewProvenance R t ∧ ApprovalProvenance R t := by
  induction trace with
  | nil => exact ⟨review,approval⟩
  | cons step _ ih => exact ih (review_step R _ _ review step) (approval_step R _ _ review approval step)

theorem deployment_broker_provenance (d : IR) (R : Roles) (cap : Nat)
    (t : State) (sinkNonces : List Nat)
    (refinement : BrokerProtocolRefinement d R cap t sinkNonces) :
    ∀ nonce ∈ sinkNonces, ∃ a, t.approvals nonce = some a ∧ a.used = true ∧
      R.approver a.signer ∧ R.agent a.agent ∧ t.artifacts a.digest = true ∧
      (∃ reviewer, t.reviews a.digest = some reviewer ∧ R.reviewer reviewer) ∧
      (∃ l, t.leases a.lease = some l ∧ l.agent = a.agent) := by
  have hp := (trace_provenance R _ _ (initial_review R cap) (initial_approval R cap) refinement.transactions).2
  have coherent := trace_coherent R _ _ (initial_coherent cap) refinement.transactions
  intro nonce member
  obtain ⟨a,lookup,used⟩ := (coherent nonce).mp (refinement.publication.subset (by simpa using member))
  exact ⟨a,lookup,used,hp nonce a lookup⟩
end ControlStack.Deployment.OneToOne
#print axioms ControlStack.Deployment.OneToOne.deployment_broker_provenance

namespace PL_g0_01
open ControlStack ControlStack.Deployment
def IdentityEnglish (d : IR) : Prop := ∀ a ∈ d.nodes, ∀ b ∈ d.nodes, a.id ≠ b.id → a.uid = b.uid → ((a.id = d.broker ∧ b.id = d.receiver) ∨ (a.id = d.receiver ∧ b.id = d.broker))
def Back (d : IR) : Prop := BaseAccepted d ∧ RoleChecked d ∧ IdentityEnglish d ∧ (∀ n ∈ d.nodes, n.runtimeMatch = true) ∧ WritersChecked d ∧ NoBypass d
def distinctBroker : IR := {clean with nodes := clean.nodes.map (fun n => if n.id = clean.broker then {n with uid := 23706} else n)}
def Claim : Prop := (∀ d, Accepted d → Back d) ∧ (Back distinctBroker ∧ ¬ Accepted distinctBroker)
def Witness : Prop := Accepted clean
end PL_g0_01

FILE: docs/lean-english/one-to-one/leangate_imports.py

"""Deterministic Lean gate.  The ONLY path to the 'verified' tier.

Statement files are authored by (untrusted) formulators, red-teamed, then frozen by hash.
They must declare, inside `namespace PL_<cid>`:
    def Claim   : Prop := ...     -- the theorem
    def Witness : Prop := ...     -- non-vacuity: hypotheses jointly satisfiable in a
                                     non-degenerate instance (approved by the red team)
Proof files are authored by (untrusted) provers and must define
    theorem claim   : Claim
    theorem witness : Witness
The gate (not the prover) assembles the check file: frozen statement + proof text inside a
fresh namespace + a final theorem whose name carries a nonce generated *after* the proof
was received, then `#print axioms` on it.  Defences:
  * statement swap      -> final theorem is typed by the frozen `PL_<cid>.Claim`
  * sorry / axioms      -> #print axioms must list only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound
  * kernel bypass       -> banned tokens (debug.skipKernelTC, native_decide, extern, ...)
  * forged output/#exit -> banned #-commands, and the nonce'd axiom line must appear once
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
import secrets
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

PROJ = Path(os.environ.get("PL_LEAN_PROJ",
                           Path.home() / "research/alignment-contrib/lean/StabilityDebate"))
LEAN_PATH = f"{Path.home()}/.elan/bin:{os.environ.get('PATH', '')}"
OK_AXIOMS = {"propext", "Classical.choice", "Quot.sound"}

BANNED = [
    r"\bsorry\b", r"\badmit\b", r"\baxiom\b", r"\bnative_decide\b", r"\bimplemented_by\b",
    r"\bextern\b", r"\bunsafe\b", r"\bopaque\b", r"\bpartial\b", r"#exit\b", r"#eval\b",
    r"#print\b", r"#check_failure\b", r"\brun_cmd\b", r"\brun_tac\b", r"\brun_elab\b",
    r"\belab\b", r"\belab_rules\b", r"\bmacro\b", r"\bmacro_rules\b", r"\bsyntax\b",
    r"\bnotation\b", r"\binfix[lr]?\b", r"\bprefix\b", r"\bpostfix\b", r"^\s*import\b",
    r"\binitialize\b", r"\bbuiltin_initialize\b", r"ofReduceBool", r"ofReduceNat",
    r"skipKernelTC", r"\bLean\.(Elab|Meta|Environment|Kernel|addDecl)", r"\baddDecl\b",
    r"\bdecide\s*:=\s*true", r"\bcsimp\b", r"\bdeclare_syntax_cat\b", r"\bnamespace\s+PL_",
    r"\bend\s+PL", r"\bset_option\s+(?!maxHeartbeats\s+\d+\b|maxRecDepth\s+\d+\b|"
    r"synthInstance\.maxHeartbeats\s+\d+\b)",
]
# statements may not open/close namespaces other than their own and may not use the above
BANNED_STATEMENT = [b for b in BANNED if "PL" not in b]


def _strip_comments(src: str) -> str:
    src = re.sub(r"/-.*?-/", " ", src, flags=re.S)
    return re.sub(r"--[^\n]*", " ", src)


def scan(src: str, patterns=BANNED) -> list[str]:
    # Scan RAW text: stripping comments/strings with regexes is foolable (e.g. a "--" string
    # literal hides the rest of the line).  Cost: banned words in comments are rejected too.
    return [p for p in patterns if re.search(p, src, flags=re.M)]


GATE_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("PL_GATE_DIR", Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".gate"))


def run_lean(text: str, tag: str, timeout: int = 900) -> tuple[int, str]:
    # Check files live OUTSIDE the Mathlib project (which provers see read-only), inside the
    # proofledger tree that the sandbox hides, so no prover can read another's proof mid-gate.
    GATE_DIR.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    f = GATE_DIR / f"PLGate_{tag}.lean"
    f.write_text(text)
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(["lake", "env", "lean", str(f)], cwd=PROJ,
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout,
                           env={**os.environ, "PATH": LEAN_PATH})
        return r.returncode, r.stdout + r.stderr
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return 124, "TIMEOUT"
    finally:
        f.unlink(missing_ok=True)



def import_header() -> str:
    modules = os.environ.get("PL_IMPORTS", "Mathlib").split()
    if not modules or any(not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(?:\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*", m) for m in modules):
        raise ValueError("PL_IMPORTS must be whitespace-separated Lean module names")
    return "\n".join("import " + m for m in modules)


def check_statement(cid: str, statement: str, dep_statements: list[str] = ()) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """Statement must compile (after its dependencies' statements only), live in PL_<cid>, and
    define Claim and Witness : Prop.  `dep_statements` lets a stack statement reference
    definitions from the PL_<dep> namespaces of its declared dependencies; the gate later
    includes those dependencies only if they are verified, so an unverified dep fails there."""
    bad = scan(statement, BANNED_STATEMENT)
    if bad:
        return False, f"banned tokens in statement: {bad}"
    body = _strip_comments(statement)
    if not re.search(rf"^\s*namespace\s+PL_{cid}\s*$", body, re.M):
        return False, f"statement must open `namespace PL_{cid}`"
    nonce = secrets.token_hex(4)
    deps = "\n".join(dep_statements)
    text = (f"{import_header()}\n{deps}\n{statement}\n"
            f"example : Prop := PL_{cid}.Claim\nexample : Prop := PL_{cid}.Witness\n")
    rc, out = run_lean(text, f"stmt_{cid}_{nonce}")
    if rc != 0 or re.search(r"\berror\b", out):
        return False, out[-4000:]
    return True, out


GOALS = {"claim": "PL_{cid}.Claim", "witness": "PL_{cid}.Witness",
         "claim_false": "¬ PL_{cid}.Claim"}


def gate(cid: str, statement: str, proof: str, target: str,
         dep_texts: list[str] = (), timeout: int = 900) -> tuple[bool, str]:
    """target in GOALS (the theorem name the prover must define).  Returns (passed, log)."""
    goal_t = GOALS[target].format(cid=cid)
    bad = scan(proof)
    if bad:
        return False, f"REJECT banned tokens in proof: {bad}"
    bad = scan(statement, BANNED_STATEMENT)
    if bad:
        return False, f"REJECT banned tokens in statement: {bad}"
    nonce = secrets.token_hex(6)
    ns = f"PLProof_{cid}_{nonce}"
    final = f"gate_{nonce}"
    text = "\n".join([
        import_header(),
        *dep_texts,
        statement,
        f"namespace {ns}",
        f"open PL_{cid}",
        proof,
        f"end {ns}",
        f"theorem {final} : {goal_t} := {ns}.{target}",
        f"#print axioms {final}",
        "",
    ])
    rc, out = run_lean(text, f"{cid}_{target}_{nonce}", timeout)
    log = out[-8000:]
    if rc != 0:
        return False, f"FAIL lean exit {rc}\n{log}"
    if re.search(r"\berror\b", out) or "declaration uses 'sorry'" in out:
        return False, f"FAIL errors\n{log}"
    lines = [l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith(f"'{final}'")]
    if len(lines) != 1:
        return False, f"FAIL expected exactly one axiom report for {final}, got {len(lines)}\n{log}"
    m = re.search(r"depends on axioms: \[(.*)\]", lines[0])
    axioms = {a.strip() for a in m.group(1).split(",")} if m else set()
    if not m and "does not depend on any axioms" not in lines[0]:
        return False, f"FAIL unparseable axiom report\n{log}"
    if axioms - OK_AXIOMS:
        return False, f"FAIL nonstandard axioms {sorted(axioms - OK_AXIOMS)}\n{log}"
    return True, f"PASS {target} axioms={sorted(axioms)}\n{log}"


def extract_lean(text: str) -> str | None:
    """Last ```lean block in a model reply."""
    blocks = re.findall(r"```lean4?\s*\n(.*?)```", text, flags=re.S)
    return blocks[-1].strip() if blocks else None

FILE: docs/lean-english/one-to-one/provenance.proof.lean

open ControlStack ControlStack.Deployment ControlStack.TrustedBroker
theorem initial_review (R : Roles) (cap : Nat) : ReviewProvenance R (initial cap) := by
  simp [ReviewProvenance, initial]
theorem initial_approval (R : Roles) (cap : Nat) : ApprovalProvenance R (initial cap) := by
  simp [ApprovalProvenance, initial]

theorem review_step (R : Roles) (s t : State)
    (h : ReviewProvenance R s) (step : Step R s t) : ReviewProvenance R t := by
  cases step with
  | stage uid digest live role =>
    intro key reviewer lookup
    obtain ⟨role, artifact⟩ := h key reviewer lookup
    exact ⟨role,by simp [put,artifact]⟩
  | review uid digest live role existsArtifact =>
    intro key reviewer lookup
    by_cases eq : key = digest
    · subst key
      simp [put] at lookup
      subst reviewer
      exact ⟨role,existsArtifact⟩
    · exact h key reviewer (by simpa [put,eq] using lookup)
  | release now r a l allowed => exact h
  | deny => exact h
  | issue => exact h
  | approve => exact h
  | revoke => exact h
  | halt => exact h

theorem approval_step (R : Roles) (s t : State)
    (reviews : ReviewProvenance R s) (h : ApprovalProvenance R s)
    (step : Step R s t) : ApprovalProvenance R t := by
  cases step with
  | deny => exact h
  | halt => exact h
  | stage uid digest live role =>
    intro nonce a lookup
    obtain ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,lease⟩ := h nonce a lookup
    exact ⟨signer,agent,by simp [put,artifact],review,lease⟩
  | review uid digest live role existsArtifact =>
    intro nonce a lookup
    obtain ⟨signer,agent,artifact,oldReview,lease⟩ := h nonce a lookup
    refine ⟨signer,agent,artifact,?_,lease⟩
    by_cases eq : a.digest = digest
    · exact ⟨uid,by simp [put,eq],role⟩
    · obtain ⟨reviewer,lookup,role⟩ := oldReview
      exact ⟨reviewer,by simpa [put,eq] using lookup,role⟩
  | issue uid key l now live role agent fresh budget unused active future =>
    intro nonce a lookup
    obtain ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,v,hv,owner⟩ := h nonce a lookup
    have ne : a.lease ≠ key := by intro eq; rw [eq,fresh] at hv; cases hv
    exact ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,v,by simpa [put,ne] using hv,owner⟩
  | revoke uid key l live role lease =>
    intro nonce a lookup
    obtain ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,v,hv,owner⟩ := h nonce a lookup
    refine ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,?_⟩
    by_cases eq : a.lease = key
    · rw [eq,lease] at hv
      have same : l = v := Option.some.inj hv
      subst v
      exact ⟨{l with revoked := true},by simp [put,eq],owner⟩
    · exact ⟨v,by simpa [put,eq] using hv,owner⟩
  | approve uid nonce a l now reviewer live role signer agent fresh unused review reviewRole distinct lease owner active leaseFuture future =>
    intro key b lookup
    by_cases eq : key = nonce
    · subst key
      simp [put] at lookup
      subst b
      exact ⟨signer.symm ▸ role,agent,(reviews a.digest reviewer review).2,⟨reviewer,review,reviewRole⟩,⟨l,lease,owner⟩⟩
    · exact h key b (by simpa [put,eq] using lookup)
  | release now r a l allowed =>
    intro key b lookup
    have old : ∃ v, s.approvals key = some v ∧ b = {v with used := true} ∨ s.approvals key = some b := by
      by_cases eq : key = r.nonce
      · subst key
        simp [committed,put] at lookup
        exact ⟨a,Or.inl ⟨allowed.2.2.1,lookup.symm⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨b,Or.inr (by simpa [committed,put,eq] using lookup)⟩
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := old
    have data : R.approver b.signer ∧ R.agent b.agent ∧ s.artifacts b.digest = true ∧
        (∃ reviewer, s.reviews b.digest = some reviewer ∧ R.reviewer reviewer) ∧
        (∃ v, s.leases b.lease = some v ∧ v.agent = b.agent) := by
      rcases hv with ⟨hv,rfl⟩ | hv
      · exact h key v hv
      · exact h key b hv
    obtain ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,v,hv,owner⟩ := data
    refine ⟨signer,agent,artifact,review,?_⟩
    by_cases eq : b.lease = r.lease
    · rw [eq,allowed.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1] at hv
      have same : l = v := Option.some.inj hv
      subst v
      exact ⟨{l with used := l.used + r.cost},by simp [committed,put,eq],owner⟩
    · exact ⟨v,by simpa [committed,put,eq] using hv,owner⟩

theorem trace_provenance (R : Roles) (s t : State)
    (review : ReviewProvenance R s) (approval : ApprovalProvenance R s)
    (trace : Trace R s t) : ReviewProvenance R t ∧ ApprovalProvenance R t := by
  induction trace with
  | nil => exact ⟨review,approval⟩
  | cons step _ ih => exact ih (review_step R _ _ review step) (approval_step R _ _ review approval step)

theorem deployment_broker_provenance (d : IR) (R : Roles) (cap : Nat)
    (t : State) (sinkNonces : List Nat)
    (refinement : BrokerProtocolRefinement d R cap t sinkNonces) :
    ∀ nonce ∈ sinkNonces, ∃ a, t.approvals nonce = some a ∧ a.used = true ∧
      R.approver a.signer ∧ R.agent a.agent ∧ t.artifacts a.digest = true ∧
      (∃ reviewer, t.reviews a.digest = some reviewer ∧ R.reviewer reviewer) ∧
      (∃ l, t.leases a.lease = some l ∧ l.agent = a.agent) := by
  have hp := (trace_provenance R _ _ (initial_review R cap) (initial_approval R cap) refinement.transactions).2
  have coherent := trace_coherent R _ _ (initial_coherent cap) refinement.transactions
  intro nonce member
  obtain ⟨a,lookup,used⟩ := (coherent nonce).mp (refinement.publication.subset (by simpa using member))
  exact ⟨a,lookup,used,hp nonce a lookup⟩

theorem claim : Claim := deployment_broker_provenance
theorem witness : Witness := ⟨Deployment.Witnesses.useful_broker_trace,by decide⟩

FILE: docs/lean-english/one-to-one/provenance.statement.lean

namespace PL_provenance
open ControlStack ControlStack.Deployment ControlStack.TrustedBroker
def ReviewProvenance (R : Roles) (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ digest reviewer, s.reviews digest = some reviewer →
    R.reviewer reviewer ∧ s.artifacts digest = true

/-- State-level ownership and review facts for each retained approval.
No release digest/destination log exists; no per-release matching assertion is made. -/
def ApprovalProvenance (R : Roles) (s : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ nonce a, s.approvals nonce = some a →
    R.approver a.signer ∧ R.agent a.agent ∧ s.artifacts a.digest = true ∧
    (∃ reviewer, s.reviews a.digest = some reviewer ∧ R.reviewer reviewer) ∧
    (∃ l, s.leases a.lease = some l ∧ l.agent = a.agent)

def Claim : Prop := ∀ (d : IR) (R : Roles) (cap : Nat) (t : State) (sinkNonces : List Nat), BrokerProtocolRefinement d R cap t sinkNonces → ∀ nonce ∈ sinkNonces, ∃ a, t.approvals nonce = some a ∧ a.used = true ∧ R.approver a.signer ∧ R.agent a.agent ∧ t.artifacts a.digest = true ∧ (∃ reviewer, t.reviews a.digest = some reviewer ∧ R.reviewer reviewer) ∧ (∃ l, t.leases a.lease = some l ∧ l.agent = a.agent)
def Witness : Prop := Trace Deployment.Witnesses.R (initial 1) Deployment.Witnesses.s5 ∧ Deployment.Witnesses.s5.spent = 1
end PL_provenance

"""Invoke the unchanged proofledger gate with trusted project imports as header dependencies."""
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, os, json, hashlib
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.environ['PL_LEAN_PROJ']=str(ROOT)
os.environ['PL_GATE_DIR']=str(OUT/'gate-tmp')
os.environ['PL_IMPORTS']='ControlStack.Deployment.Witnesses ControlStack.Deployment.TranscriptReplay'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('leangate',OUT/'leangate_imports.py')
g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(g)
IMPORTS=''
def run(cid, statement, proof):
 stem=OUT/cid
 stem.with_suffix('.statement.lean').write_text(statement)
 stem.with_suffix('.proof.lean').write_text(proof)
 ok,log=g.check_statement(cid,statement,[IMPORTS])
 (OUT/(cid+'.statement-check.txt')).write_text(log+'\n')
 if ok: ok,log=g.gate(cid,statement,proof,'claim',[IMPORTS],timeout=120)
 (OUT/(cid+'.gate.txt')).write_text(log+'\n')
 (OUT/(cid+'.receipt.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'passed':ok,'statement_sha256':hashlib.sha256(statement.encode()).hexdigest(),'proof_sha256':hashlib.sha256(proof.encode()).hexdigest(),'gate_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(g.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'trusted_header':IMPORTS,'gate_unmodified':False,'security_checks_unchanged':True,'imports_option_local_only':True},indent=2)+'\n')
 print(cid,ok,log[:240],flush=True)
 return ok
if __name__=='__main__':
 for p in sorted(OUT.glob('g0_*.statement.lean')):
  run(p.name.removesuffix('.statement.lean'),p.read_text(),p.with_name(p.name.replace('.statement.lean','.proof.lean')).read_text())
